Container.Name: GM-Encoder
Container.Overview:
VMAF-targeted video encoder as a watch-folder daemon. Drop videos in the input share and it finds the optimal CRF for your target quality (terranvigil/dynamic-crf + ffmpeg/libvmaf), encodes, and remuxes all audio/subtitle/attachment/chapter streams from the original.
Pick the encoder from the Codec dropdown, or leave it on 'auto' to detect the passed-through GPU. Supports NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD/Intel VAAPI and CPU.
GPU ACCESS is controlled by Extra Parameters (below): - NVIDIA : --runtime=nvidia --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri/ (needs Nvidia-Driver plugin) - Intel/AMD (QSV/VAAPI) : --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri/ - CPU only : leave Extra Parameters empty

Config.Name: Web GUI port
Config.Description: Open http://UNRAID-IP:PORT for the control panel (settings, live progress, manual encode, pause/stop).

Config.Name: Input share
Config.Description: Drop videos here to encode (scanned recursively).

Config.Name: Output share
Config.Description: Encoded files land here.

Config.Name: Config/appdata
Config.Description: Logs + state (processed/failed lists).

Config.Name: Codec
Config.Description: auto = detect the passed-through GPU and use the Family below. Or pick an explicit encoder. Make sure Extra Parameters passes the matching device/runtime.

Config.Name: Codec family (for auto)
Config.Description: Which codec family 'auto' should target. hevc = best support, av1 = smallest (needs newer GPU), h264 = most compatible.

Config.Name: Optimize (VMAF search)
Config.Description: true = find the best CRF for the VMAF target. false = fixed quality (Manual CRF).

Config.Name: VMAF target
Config.Description: Quality target 0-100. 95 = archival, 93 = high (recommended), 90 = smaller.

Config.Name: VMAF tolerance
Config.Description: Acceptable +/- band around the target.

Config.Name: Initial CRF
Config.Description: Search starting point.

Config.Name: Min CRF (worst)
Config.Description: Highest CRF number the search may use.

Config.Name: Max CRF (best)
Config.Description: Lowest CRF number the search may use.

Config.Name: Manual CRF/QP
Config.Description: Used only when Optimize = false.

Config.Name: Scale height
Config.Description: 0 = keep source resolution. e.g. 1080 downscales to 1080p.

Config.Name: Remux original streams
Config.Description: Copy all audio/subs/attachments/chapters from the source.

Config.Name: Output container
Config.Description: Output file type.

Config.Name: Output suffix
Config.Description: Appended to the filename.

Config.Name: Output subdirectory
Config.Description: SAME_AS_SRC = mirror the input folder structure. Empty = flat into /output. Or a fixed folder name.

Config.Name: Auto watch-folder
Config.Description: true = auto-encode files dropped in the input share. false = GUI/manual only (you pick files in the web UI).

Config.Name: After success
Config.Description: What to do with the source after a successful encode. move = to input/done.

Config.Name: Keep larger output
Config.Description: false = discard the result if it is not smaller than the source.

Config.Name: Poll interval (s)
Config.Description: How often to scan the input share.

Config.Name: File stable (s)
Config.Description: Wait this long after the last write before encoding (avoids partial copies).

Config.Name: Scan existing on start
Config.Description: Process files already present when the container starts.

Config.Name: Input extensions
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of file types to watch.

Config.Name: VAAPI render device
Config.Description: Only for *_vaapi codecs.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Your GPU UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page (e.g. GPU-xxxxxxxx-...), or 'all'.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Leave as 'all' for NVENC.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id for output files (Unraid = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id for output files (Unraid = 100).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask.
